shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
I often go for walks in the park near my house.
Cooking new recipes is something I find really fun.
Traveling to different countries broadens my perspective.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
I believe that learning a new language is very rewarding.
Spending time with family creates lasting memories together.
I think volunteering in the community is important for everyone.
Gardening is a wonderful hobby that connects us to nature.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you tell me about a memorable trip you took?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: How do you feel travel impacts your life?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about the importance of music.
questions: Q1: What role has music played in your life?
Q2: Have you ever faced any difficulties in learning an instrument?
Q3: Why do you think music is so influential in our culture?
Q4: What tips would you give to someone wanting to get into music?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental behaviors.
questions: Q1: What eco-friendly habits do you practice regularly?
Q2: Have you encountered any challenges in living sustainably?
Q3: What is your opinion on the importance of environmental protection?
Q4: What suggestions would you make for someone wanting to be more eco-conscious?
